brief.zh: 看输入和输出，选出是哪个 3×3 核做的（按<part-ref to="kernel3"></part-ref>元件的读法）。10 轮对 8 轮过关，越往后越快。
brief.en: Look at the input and the output, and pick the 3×3 kernel that made it (read the way the <part-ref to="kernel3"></part-ref> part reads it). Get 8 of 10 rounds right to pass; it gets faster as you go.

hint.zh: 权重全正、和为 1：变软。正负相抵、和为 0：平坦处变 0。只有一个 1：整张图挪了一格。
hint.en: All weights positive, summing to 1: softer. Positives and negatives cancelling, summing to 0: flat areas become 0. A single 1: the whole image shifts by one pixel.

after.zh: 你已经能从结果反推核：全正且和为 1 是平滑，越集中越接近原图；和为 0 的核只对变化有反应，是求导；中心大、四周为负是锐化；只有一个 1 是平移，挪的方向和 1 的位置相反。
after.en: You can now work back from a result to its kernel. All positive and summing to 1 is smoothing, and the more concentrated, the closer to the original. A kernel that sums to 0 responds only to change: a derivative. A large centre with negative neighbours is sharpening. A single 1 is a shift, moving the opposite way from where the 1 sits.

t.zh: 这一章的平均、高斯、差分、锐化，连同把图挪一格的平移，都能写成一个 3×3 核。熟练以后，看一眼处理前后的图，就该猜得出用了什么核。
t.en: This chapter's average, Gaussian, difference and sharpen, along with the shift that moves an image by one pixel, can all be written as a 3×3 kernel. With practice, one look at an image before and after should tell you which kernel was used.

caption.en: A kernel passing over the whole image

t.zh: 台上每轮给一张输入和一张输出，下面四个元件各是一个核，数字按<part-ref to="kernel3"></part-ref>元件的读法排列。选出做出这张输出的那一个。
t.en: Each round, the bench shows an input and an output. Each of the four parts below is a kernel, with its numbers laid out the way the <part-ref to="kernel3"></part-ref> part reads them. Pick the one that made this output.

t.zh: 一共十轮，对八轮过关，越往后给的时间越短，也可以关掉计时先练。要想的问题：不逐格去算，只扫一眼核里的数，你靠什么认出它？
t.en: There are ten rounds, and eight right answers pass. Later rounds give you less time, and you can switch the timer off to practise first. Something to think about: without working it out cell by cell, just glancing at the numbers in a kernel, how do you recognise it?
